name: security-critical
description: Security-sensitive change with threat analysis, strict verification, two reviews, mandatory human approval.

stages.title: Threat and abuse-case analysis
stages.instruction: Identify trust boundaries, attacker goals, abuse cases, sensitive assets, authorization assumptions, and required security tests before coding.

stages.title: Implement bounded change
stages.instruction: Implement only the requested bounded change. Inspect the repository first; preserve unrelated changes.
